name: Asahi (Toyama, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Asahi town emblem in white: a ring with three pointed strokes, like a stylised three-armed device.
history: Municipal flag of Asahi, a town in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1954.

features.role: Asahi town emblem — a ring with three pointed strokes, like a stylised three-armed device
